lane: شَئِيتٌ A horse _that has a habit of stumbling;_ or _that stumbles often:_ (S, K:) it has no corresponding verb: and accord. to As, it signifies (S) a horse _whose hind hoofs fall short of reaching_ [_the spots that have been trodden by_] _his fore hoofs:_ (S, K:) [but see شَبُوبٌ:] pl. شُؤُوتٌ. (TA.) [See also أَحَقُّ.]

entries.text: الشئيت، كأمير من الخيل: العثور، والذي يقصر حافرا رجليه عن حافري يديه.
